units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 20) assist a notary in receiving members of the public in accordance with the public reception schedule approved by the Notarial Chamber of Sverdlovsk Oblast;
units.label: Subpoint 20 Point 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 21) provide housing to an officer holding the position of district police commissioner and the officer’s family members for the period during which the officer holds that position;
units.label: Subpoint 21 Point 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 22) implement measures to assist persons under the influence of alcohol, narcotic drugs or other toxic substances.
units.label: Subpoint 22 Point 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Matters of local significance of the municipality
units.text: 2. The municipality’s local self-government bodies may address the matters specified in point 1 of this Article, participate in the exercise of other state powers (not transferred to them in accordance with Article 19 of Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’) where such participation is provided for by federal laws, and address other matters not assigned to the competence of local self-government bodies of other municipalities or state authorities and not excluded from their competence by federal laws or laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, using local budget revenue, except interbudgetary transfers from budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation and tax revenue received under additional revenue-sharing rates.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. For the purpose of addressing matters of local significance, the municipality’s local self-government bodies have the following powers:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 1) adopting the municipal charter, amending and supplementing it, and issuing municipal legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 2) establishing official symbols of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 3) establishing municipal enterprises and institutions, financing the activities of municipal treasury-funded institutions and the performance of municipal assignments by municipal budgetary and autonomous institutions, and procuring goods, works and services to meet municipal needs;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 4) setting tariffs for services provided and work performed by municipal enterprises and institutions, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 5) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 19.11.2019 No. 47/25;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 5-1) powers to organize heat supply provided for by the Federal Law ‘On Heat Supply’;
units.label: Subpoint 5-1 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 5-2) powers in the field of water supply and wastewater disposal provided for by the Federal Law ‘On Water Supply and Wastewater Disposal’;
units.label: Subpoint 5-2 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 5-3) powers in the field of strategic planning provided for by Federal Law of 28 June 2014 No. 172-ФЗ ‘On Strategic Planning in the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Subpoint 5-3 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 6) providing organizational, material and technical support for preparing and conducting municipal elections, local referendums, votes to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg, and votes on changing the municipality’s boundaries or transforming the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 7) organizing the collection of statistical indicators characterizing the municipality’s economic and social conditions and providing those data to state authorities in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 7-1) approving and implementing municipal programmes for energy conservation and improved energy efficiency; organizing energy audits of apartment buildings whose premises constitute the municipal housing stock within the municipality’s boundaries; and organizing and implementing other measures provided for by legislation on energy conservation and improved energy efficiency;
units.label: Subpoint 7-1 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 7-2) developing and approving programmes for the comprehensive development of the municipality’s utility infrastructure systems, transport infrastructure and social infrastructure, the requirements for which are established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 7-2 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 8) conducting international and foreign economic relations in accordance with Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 9) establishing a print media outlet and/or an online publication to promulgate municipal legal acts and communicate official information to the municipality’s residents;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 9-1) organizing professional education and additional professional education for elected local self-government officials, members of elected local self-government bodies, deputies of the City Duma, municipal servants and employees of municipal institutions; and organizing the training of personnel for municipal service in accordance with the procedure provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on education and on municipal service;
units.label: Subpoint 9-1 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 10) other powers in accordance with federal law and this Charter.
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. By decision of local self-government bodies, the population may be involved, on a voluntary basis, in work of social significance to the municipality (including duty shifts) to address matters of local significance of the municipality specified in subpoints 8-1–12, 21 and 26 of point 2 of Article 9 of this Charter.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: Only work that does not require specialized professional training may be classified as work of social significance.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 10 · “Only work that does not require specialized professional…”

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: Adult residents of the municipality who are able to work are involved in work of social significance without remuneration, outside their principal work or study time, no more than once every three months. Such work may last no more than four consecutive hours.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 10 · “Adult residents of the municipality who are able to work are…”

units.locator: Article 10. Powers of the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. The powers of local self-government bodies established by federal law and this Charter are exercised independently.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. Individual state powers are vested in the municipality’s local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Local self-government bodies may be vested with individual state powers for an unlimited period or, where those powers have a specified duration, for the duration of those powers.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. Individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies are financed solely through subventions provided to the municipal budget from the federal and oblast budgets.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 3-1. To protect the municipality’s interests and improve the effectiveness of the exercise of individual state powers transferred to them, local self-government bodies may additionally use their own material resources and financial funds to exercise those powers if the City Duma adopts the corresponding decision.
units.label: Point 3-1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: A decision to use additional own funds and material resources to exercise individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies, specifying the amount of funds, the list of material resources, and the justification and procedure for their use, is adopted by the City Duma annually before the beginning of the next financial year (during the financial year), on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 3-1 Art. 11 · “A decision to use additional own funds and material resources…”

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 4. Local self-government bodies bear responsibility for exercising individual state powers according to the procedure established by the relevant federal and oblast laws, within the material resources and funds allocated to the municipality for those purposes.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Exercise of individual state powers by the municipality’s local self-government bodies
units.text: 5. Local self-government bodies participate in the exercise of state powers not transferred to them in accordance with Article 19 of Federal Law of 6 October 2003 No. 131-ФЗ ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’ if the City Duma adopts a decision to exercise the right to participate in those powers.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 11

units.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
units.text: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
units.label: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION

units.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
units.text: OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT AND PARTICIPATION OF THE POPULATION
units.label: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION · “OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT AND PARTICIPATION OF THE POPULATION”

units.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
units.text: IN THE EXERCISE OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT
units.label: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION · “IN THE EXERCISE OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT”

units.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
units.text: Article 11-1. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population of the municipality and participation of the population of the municipality in the exercise of local self-government
units.label: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION · “Article 11-1. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government…”

units.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
units.text: 1. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the population of the municipality include: local referendums; municipal elections; and votes to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION · “1. Forms of direct exercise of local self-government by the…”

units.locator: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION
units.text: 2. Forms of participation of the population of the municipality in the exercise of local self-government include: votes on changing the municipality’s boundaries or transforming the municipality; citizens’ assemblies; citizens’ law-making initiatives; initiative projects; territorial public self-government; the headperson of a rural settlement; public hearings; public discussions; citizens’ meetings; citizens’ conferences (meetings of delegates); citizens’ surveys; citizens’ appeals to the municipality’s local self-government bodies; the Civic Chamber of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”; and other forms provided for by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and other municipal legal acts.
units.label: Chapter III. FORMS OF DIRECT EXERCISE BY THE POPULATION · “2. Forms of participation of the population of the municipality…”

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: Article 12. Local referendum
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: 1. A local referendum may be held for the population of the municipality to address matters of local significance directly.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: 2. A local referendum is held on the basis of universal, equal and direct expression of will by secret ballot.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: The decision to call a local referendum is adopted by the City Duma on the initiative of the entities specified by federal law.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 12 · “The decision to call a local referendum is adopted by the City…”

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: 3. The procedure for calling and holding a local referendum and determining its results is established by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: The registration certificate issued to an initiative group for a local referendum is valid from the day following registration of that initiative group until the day the local referendum campaign ends, as determined in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in referendums.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12 · “The registration certificate issued to an initiative group for…”

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: The registration certificate issued to another group of participants in a local referendum is valid from the day following registration of that other group until the day the local referendum campaign ends, as determined in accordance with the federal law establishing basic guarantees of the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in referendums.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 12 · “The registration certificate issued to another group of…”

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: 4. The voting totals and the decision adopted in a local referendum are subject to official publication (promulgation).
units.label: Point 4 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: Municipal regulatory legal acts adopted in a local referendum are forwarded by the Head of Yekaterinburg for publication in the official print publication designated for official publication (promulgation) of City Duma decisions.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 12 · “Municipal regulatory legal acts adopted in a local referendum…”

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: 5. A decision adopted in a local referendum is binding throughout the municipality’s territory and does not require approval by state authorities, local self-government bodies or their officials.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: A local referendum may not be held within two years from official publication of the results of a local referendum with a question formulated to have the same meaning.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 12 · “A local referendum may not be held within two years from…”

units.locator: Article 12. Local referendum
units.text: 6. Guarantees of citizens’ rights to participate in a local referendum are established by federal law.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 13. Municipal elections
units.text: Article 13. Municipal elections
units.label: Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Municipal elections
units.text: 1. Municipal elections are held to elect deputies of the City Duma on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Municipal elections
units.text: 2. Repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 12.10.2010 No. 62/29.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Municipal elections
units.text: 3. The procedure for calling, preparing and conducting municipal elections, establishing voting totals and determining election results, and guarantees of citizens’ electoral rights in those elections are established by federal law and a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Municipal elections
units.text: 4. The voting totals and results of municipal elections are subject to official publication (promulgation).
units.label: Point 4 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. A vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg is held on the population’s initiative in accordance with the procedure established for local referendums by federal law and a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast, taking account of the special provisions of the federal law establishing the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. The grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg are established by this Charter.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Vote to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. The procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg must ensure the Head’s right to explain to voters the circumstances put forward as grounds for recall.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The grounds for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg are:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Grounds and procedure for recalling the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) specific unlawful decisions, where confirmed through judicial proceedings;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 15
